item.title: When Networking Doesn't Work
item.description:
📝 I also tried native Windows software (ipmiutil) with effectively identical result — the SMDC would not respond. That shot down my working theory that something in recent Windows 10/11 ate the IPMI UDP packets. That was even more suspicious.

item.title: What I'm Hearing About Cognitive Debt (So Far)
item.description:
📝 Cognitive Debt Hurts Developers, Not Just the Software Technical debt lives in the code. Cognitive debt lives in people. Cognitive Debt, Like Technical Debt, Must Be Repaid Martin Fowler notes that, like technical debt, cognitive debt must eventually be repaid.
🔗 Read more: https://margaretstorey.com/blog/2026/02/18/cognitive-debt-revisited/
